stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
stages.text: Xavier leads the X-Men, with Scott as his field leader.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's field leader.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#34
stages.text: Grieving the loss of Jean, Scott lashes out at Xavier and quits the X-Men. He comes back with his faith in Xavier's ideals renewed.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's field leader. Quits in grief over Jean, then returns.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor. Scott walks out on him, then comes back.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#9
proposed.text: Scott confronts the returned Xavier for leaving everything to Magneto, and Xavier says he wanted Scott and Jean free to live normal lives. Scott then leads the team that goes with him to Asteroid M.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's field leader. Confronts him for leaving everything to Magneto.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor. Wanted Scott and Jean free to live normal lives.

their_evidence: Ep 9 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2): Scott argues with Xavier over leaving everything to Magneto; Xavier says he wanted Scott and Jean to leave and live normal lives. Cyclops's Blue Team, with Xavier, goes to Asteroid M.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
stages.text: Xavier leads Wolverine on the X-Men.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's most unruly X-Man.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's leader.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#3
stages.text: Logan clashes with Xavier, as when Xavier tries to reform Sabretooth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's most unruly X-Man.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's leader. Logan respects him but often argues with him.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#9
proposed.text: On Asteroid M, Xavier talks Logan out of killing Magneto, then begs Magneto to stop when he rips the adamantium from Logan's body.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's most unruly X-Man. Talked down from killing Magneto.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's leader. Begs Magneto to stop tearing out his adamantium.

their_evidence: Ep 9: Wolverine wants to kill Magneto and Xavier talks him down; after Magneto tears the adamantium from Wolverine, Xavier pleads with Magneto to stop. Wikipedia: Xavier's attempt on Magneto's mind is blocked until Wolverine stabs Magneto.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
stages.text: Rogue is one of Xavier's X-Men.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's X-Men.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rogue's mentor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#22
stages.text: Xavier took Rogue in and healed her mind after she absorbed Ms. Marvel.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Taken in and healed by Xavier.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Took Rogue in and healed her mind.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#9
proposed.text: Rogue confronts the returned Xavier with her anger and he apologizes to her, but she still leaves to join Magneto on Asteroid M.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Angry at Xavier on his return. Joins Magneto instead.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Apologizes to Rogue on his return.

their_evidence: Ep 9: Rogue voices her displeasure with Xavier and he apologizes (and confirms Moira died on Genosha). Wikipedia: Magneto invites the X-Men to Asteroid M, which Rogue and Roberto do.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#2
stages.text: Logan clashes with Scott over his call to leave Morph behind.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Scott's call to leave Morph behind.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Leaves Morph behind, to Logan's fury.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#5
stages.text: Scott and Logan clash again and again over Jean.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's rival for Jean.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's rival for Jean.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#10
proposed.text: With Logan lying unconscious after Magneto tears out his adamantium, Scott urges him to pull through and not break Jean's heart.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's rival for Jean. Scott urges him to pull through.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's rival for Jean. Urges him to pull through for her.

their_evidence: Ep 10 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3): Cyclops urges the unconscious Wolverine to recover, telling him not to break Jean's heart and to be 'the best at what you do'.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#45
stages.text: Logan lends Rogue his healing to fight off the alien Colony's spores.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Logan lends her his healing to fight off the Colony's spores.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Saves Rogue with his healing.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#8
proposed.text: When Prime Sentinels attack the mansion, Logan fights his way through them to reach the unconscious Rogue and protect her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Logan fights through Prime Sentinels to protect her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Protects Rogue from the Prime Sentinels at the mansion.

their_evidence: Ep 8 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1): Rogue is unconscious after a Prime Sentinel attack and Wolverine fights through several Sentinels to reach and protect her as the mansion burns.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#53
stages.text: Logan, Rogue, and Gambit protect Kurt from a fearful mob in Germany, and Logan learns something about faith from him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The monk who teaches Logan about faith.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Protects Kurt from a fearful mob in Germany.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#8
proposed.text: Logan and Kurt fight off the Prime Sentinels side by side to protect the unconscious Rogue as the mansion burns.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Prime Sentinels beside Logan at the mansion.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Prime Sentinels beside Kurt to protect Rogue.

their_evidence: Ep 8: Nightcrawler joins Wolverine, now wielding swords, and the two fight Sentinels together to protect Rogue.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#21
stages.text: Cable deliberately infects Logan with Apocalypse's plague so that his blood can yield a vaccine.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Infects Logan with Apocalypse's plague to make a vaccine.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Infected by Cable with Apocalypse's plague to make a vaccine.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#8
proposed.text: Logan demands to know why Cable didn't stop the Genosha massacre, and Cable explains that time kept pulling him away whenever he tried.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Says time kept pulling him away from stopping Genosha.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Demands to know why Cable didn't stop Genosha.

their_evidence: Ep 8: Wolverine questions why Cable didn't stop the events in Genosha; Cable explains he was repeatedly pulled away from that moment through time whenever he tried to act.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#22
stages.text: Jean helps Rogue master Ms. Marvel's psyche inside her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Jean helps her master Ms. Marvel's psyche.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Helps Rogue master Ms. Marvel's psyche inside her.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#7
proposed.text: When the team finds Rogue in Mexico, broken down in grief over Gambit, Jean holds her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jean holds her as she grieves Gambit.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Rogue as she grieves Gambit.

their_evidence: Ep 7 (Bright Eyes): after Rogue wakes in Mexico and breaks down over Gambit, Jean embraces her and Rogue sees the whole team with her. Wikipedia: Rogue finds Gyrich in Mexico; the X-Men get Rogue on the way to Madripoor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#5
stages.text: Storm duels the Morlock leader Callisto to free Scott.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Duels Callisto to free Scott.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Storm duels Callisto to free him.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#2
proposed.text: At Magneto's trial, Scott leaves Storm to guard Magneto and the judges, and when Jean goes into labor Storm sends Rogue to get Scott to the hospital.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Guards Magneto's trial for Scott and sends him to Jean.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leaves Storm to guard Magneto's trial.

their_evidence: Ep 2 (Mutant Liberation Begins): Cyclops orders Storm to stay in the courtroom to protect Magneto and the judges; when Cyclops gets Jean's message that she is in labor, Storm orders Rogue to take Scott to the hospital.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
stages.text: Remy helps save Jubilee from the Sentinels at the mall.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The kid Remy looks out for.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Looks out for Jubilee.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#7
stages.text: Remy breaks Jubilee out of Genosha's slave camp.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The kid Remy looks out for.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Looks out for Jubilee.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#18
proposed.text: When Cable tries to kill the unconscious Gambit, Jubilee walks out on X-Force and goes back to the X-Men.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Quits X-Force after Cable tries to kill Remy.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Brought back by Apocalypse. Cable's attempt on him drives Jubilee from X-Force.

their_evidence: Ep 18 (The Dead Man's Hand): after Rogue frees Gambit from Apocalypse's control, Cable attempts to kill the unconscious Gambit, and Jubilee and Sunspot leave with the X-Men.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#10
stages.text: Rogue drains part of Archangel's dark side while he fights as Apocalypse's Horseman.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drains part of Warren's dark side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rogue drains part of his dark side.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
stages.text: Still feeling Archangel's dark side in her, Rogue helps him hunt Apocalypse.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drains part of Warren's dark side and helps him hunt Apocalypse.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rogue drains part of his dark side and helps him hunt Apocalypse.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#19
proposed.text: When Apocalypse brainwashes the X-Men, X-Force and X-Factor, Rogue arrives with celestial power and frees them all, Archangel among them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Frees Warren from Apocalypse's control with celestial power.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Freed by Rogue from Apocalypse's control.

their_evidence: Ep 19 (Survival of the Fittest): Apocalypse brainwashes all of the X-Men, X-Force (Archangel is an active X-Force member in the episode) and X-Factor; Rogue arrives and uses her celestial powers to free Gambit and the others.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#41
stages.text: Emma Frost battles Xavier for psychic control of Jean.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Battles Xavier for control of Jean's mind.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Emma wants control of her mind.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#7
proposed.text: Searching the ruins of Genosha, Jean picks up Emma's psychic signal under the rubble, and she and Scott pull her out alive in her new diamond form.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Genosha survivor Jean finds and pulls from the rubble.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Finds Emma alive under Genosha's rubble.

their_evidence: Ep 7: Jean picks up a psychic signal from a telepath in Genosha's rubble and Emma is pulled out in her diamond form; Marvel Database: she was rescued in her diamond form by Cyclops and Jean Grey. Kind moves from enemy to ally on the rescue; keep enemy if the owner prefers the earlier through-line.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#37
stages.text: In a friendly skirmish Forge sets up between X-Factor and the X-Men, Havok faces off against Cyclops, and they find that neither one's blasts can hurt the other.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The X-Men's leader. Neither his blasts nor Havok's can hurt the other.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: X-Factor's blaster. Neither his blasts nor Scott's can hurt the other.

question: Do Havok and Cyclops deal with each other in X-Men '97? Both are active in #16, #18 and #19 (X-Factor and X-Force attack X-Corp in #19), but no source I could reach describes a scene between them, and the show never says they are brothers.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#14
stages.text: Graydon stirs up anti-mutant protests against the newly pardoned Beast and tapes a bar riot that the news then blames on him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot who stirs up protests against Beast.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The pardoned mutant Graydon targets.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#20
stages.text: Graydon tries to infect Beast with a mutant plague and infects himself instead.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot who tries to infect Beast with a plague.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The mutant Graydon tries to infect.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#23
stages.text: Beast saved Graydon's life after the plague attack, but Graydon has Beast's love Carly kidnapped, and Beast storms his headquarters to save her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot whose life Beast saves.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Saves Graydon's life, though Graydon hates him.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#17
proposed.text: After the Acolytes abduct Graydon, Beast goes to the Savage Land with the X-Men to rescue him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot Beast helps rescue from the Acolytes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Helps rescue Graydon from the Acolytes.

their_evidence: Strange Land, Savage Heart (S2E7, running #17): Nightcrawler, Rogue, Beast, Bishop and Polaris go to the Acolytes' Savage Land base to free the abducted Creed ('the man we're rescuin''); Beast is on the rescue team and at the trial. No direct one-on-one exchange found, so medium.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#2
stages.text: During the X-Men's raid on the Mutant Control Agency, a Sentinel strikes Morph down and the team has to leave him behind.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Strike Morph down in a raid.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man a Sentinel strikes down.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#51
stages.text: Morph rejoins the X-Men, and when the Sentinels return he overcomes his fear of them to destroy Master Mold.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Nearly kill Morph.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Destroys the Sentinels' Master Mold.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#9
proposed.text: Morph fights Bastion's army of Sentinels with the X-Men's Gold Team in the Galapagos Islands.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bastion's army Morph fights in the Galapagos.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Bastion's Sentinels in the Galapagos.

their_evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2 (S1E9): the Gold Team battles Bastion-controlled Sentinels at his Galapagos volcano base; transcript has Bastion speaking through the Sentinels followed by 'Morph smash!'.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#2
stages.text: Trask and Gyrich work together to round up mutants with the Sentinels.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Trask's ally.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gyrich's ally.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#1
proposed.text: Gyrich gets word to Trask from prison that the X-Men are coming for him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Warns Trask from prison that the X-Men are coming.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Sentinel maker Gyrich warns from prison.

their_evidence: To Me, My X-Men (S1E1): in the Sahara Trask tells the X-Men 'Gyrich warned me you were coming. Even in prison, he has friends...'.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#2
stages.text: Morph is Scott's teammate until Scott's call to retreat leaves him behind in a Sentinel raid.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The teammate Scott left behind.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The leader who left Morph behind.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#14
stages.text: Brainwashed by Sinister, Morph blames Scott's team for leaving him to die. He poses as the minister at Scott's wedding and turns the X-Men against each other.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes revenge on Scott's team for Sinister.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The leader Morph blames for leaving him to die.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#26
stages.text: In the Savage Land, Xavier frees Morph from Sinister's control, and Scott and the X-Men blast Sinister apart.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The teammate Scott left behind.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Left Morph behind, then helps free him from Sinister.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#3
proposed.text: Morph, once Sinister's puppet, offers to show Scott where Sinister is, and Scott lets him lead the strike to save Nathan.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Scott to Sinister's lair to save Nathan.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The leader Morph guides to Sinister's lair.

their_evidence: Fire Made Flesh (S1E3): Morph says 'I can show you where he is'; Scott answers 'Are you sure, Morph?... Fine. Lead the way.' Wikipedia: Morph leads the X-Men to Sinister's lab where Nathan is held.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#2
stages.text: Wolverine fights the Sentinels in the X-Men's raid on the Mutant Control Agency, then helps destroy their stockpile at the factory where they are built.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Robots Logan fights in the X-Men's raid.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man who fights the Sentinels.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#11
stages.text: In the Sentinel-ruled future Bishop comes from, the Sentinels have killed every X-Man but Wolverine, who lives on to send Bishop back in time.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kill Logan's friends in a dark future.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The last X-Man the Sentinels never catch.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#8
proposed.text: When Bastion's Prime Sentinels attack Xavier's school, Wolverine fights them off with his claws.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bastion's Prime Sentinels attack Logan at the school.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights the Prime Sentinels at Xavier's school.

their_evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (S1E8): Prime Sentinels activate and attack Xavier's school (Wikipedia); transcript has a Prime Sentinel taunting and Logan's 'Lady, I got six reasons why', with Nightcrawler and Rogue in the fight.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
stages.text: A Sentinel attacks the newly mutant Jubilee at a mall, and the X-Men save her. When she heads home to check on her foster parents, Sentinels capture her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The first to hunt Jubilee.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A young mutant the Sentinels capture.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#8
proposed.text: The da Costas' butler turns out to be one of Bastion's Prime Sentinels and attacks Jubilee and Roberto.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bastion's Prime Sentinels attack Jubilee and Roberto.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A young X-Man the Prime Sentinels attack.

their_evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (S1E8): at Roberto's family home the butler Ford activates ('Surrender, mutants'); Jubilee: 'Did your butler just turn into a Sentinel zombie? I am totally done with malls.'

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#20
stages.text: Bishop travels back in time to stop Apocalypse from releasing a plague that mutants will be blamed for.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bishop fights him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Apocalypse.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#66
stages.text: Bishop frees the psychics Apocalypse holds captive at the Axis of Time.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Holds psychics captive at the Axis of Time. Bishop fights him and frees them.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Apocalypse.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#13
proposed.text: Bishop tracks Nur down in ancient Egypt and fights him to get the stranded X-Men back to their own time.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bishop fights him in ancient Egypt.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Nur in ancient Egypt.

their_evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part 1 (S2E3, running #13): Bishop arrives: 'En Sabah Nur. You thought you could hide. But I found you', knocks him down ('before he comes to'); Part 2 opens with Magneto telling Bishop to stay his hand. Wikipedia: Bishop went to 3000 B.C. to rescue the X-Men.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#21
stages.text: Beast makes a vaccine from Wolverine's blood that stops the plague Apocalypse unleashes, and Apocalypse slips away.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: His plague is stopped by Beast's vaccine.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Makes the vaccine against Apocalypse's plague.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
stages.text: Beast takes control of Apocalypse's own sentient ship to trap him, but Archangel's rage ruins the plan.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Beast takes over his sentient ship to trap him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Turns Apocalypse's own ship against him.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#14
proposed.text: Beast recognizes Nur's lost temple as Ship, and once Nur becomes Apocalypse, Beast uses pieces of Ship to send the X-Men home.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Becomes Apocalypse at the temple Beast recognizes as Ship.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Recognizes Nur's temple as Ship.

their_evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part 2 (S2E4, running #14): Beast: 'This is no temple, but the mighty spacecraft Ship... a weapon of Apocalypse'; the X-Men fight to stop Nur entering the shrine; 'I was able to use pieces from Ship to repair the time-bands.' Wikipedia: Beast uses parts of Ship to create a time travel device.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#10
stages.text: Apocalypse turns Warren into one of his Horsemen and leads him against the X-Men. Beaten at Stonehenge, Warren flees in anguish.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Makes Warren one of his Horsemen.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Apocalypse's Horsemen.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
stages.text: Driven mad by his time as Apocalypse's Horseman, Warren spends his fortune hunting him for revenge.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Made Warren a Horseman.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Apocalypse's former Horseman.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#19
proposed.text: Warren storms X-Corp with X-Force to get at Apocalypse in Gambit's body, and Apocalypse seizes control of him with every mutant there until Rogue frees them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Takes control of Warren at X-Corp.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Falls under Apocalypse's control at X-Corp.

their_evidence: Survival of the Fittest (S2E9, running #19): X-Force (Cable, Psylocke, Archangel) and X-Factor attack X-Corp for Gambit's body; Apocalypse brainwashes all of the X-Men, X-Force and X-Factor ('For now, you all belong to me'); Rogue frees Gambit and the others.

stages.title: X-Men '97#5
stages.text: Rogue reveals that she had a secret romance with Magneto when she was younger, since his power lets her touch him. She agrees to lead Genosha beside him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's secret old flame.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Magneto loves.

stages.title: X-Men '97#9
stages.text: After Genosha falls, Rogue joins Magneto on his new mutant haven, Asteroid M.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's old flame, whose Asteroid M she joins.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Magneto loves, who joins him on Asteroid M.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#4
proposed.text: When Magneto attacks a chemical plant, Rogue tries to steal his power, but he keeps her from getting close and disables the X-Men.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Keeps Rogue from touching him at the chemical plant.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man who tries to drain his power.

their_evidence: Deadly Reunions (#4): Cyclops, Storm and Rogue face Magneto at the Metro Chemical factory; even Rogue, when she tries to steal some of his power, cannot get close to him, and he disarms them all. (Rogue never deals with him in Enter Magneto, #3.)

stages.title: X-Men '97#9
stages.text: Storm and Jean lead the Gold Team against Bastion's Sentinels.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Jean's co-leader on the Gold Team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Storm's co-leader on the Gold Team.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#31
proposed.text: While most of the team goes to Muir Island, Storm stays behind with Cyclops to watch over Jean as she struggles with her new power.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Watches over Jean as the Phoenix grows in her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Storm watches over after the shuttle crash.

their_evidence: The Phoenix Saga, Part III (#31): while most of the X-Men travel to Muir Island to save Xavier from Juggernaut, Storm and Cyclops remain behind to care for Jean, who then teleports to Muir Island.

stages.title: X-Men '97#5
stages.text: On Genosha, Remy watches Rogue choose to lead beside Magneto, her old flame.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Remy's rival for Rogue.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Magneto's rival for Rogue.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#48
proposed.text: Magneto welcomes Gambit, with Xavier and Beast, aboard Asteroid M as his guest, and Gambit is later jailed by the Acolytes for Magneto's supposed murder.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hosts Remy on Asteroid M.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A guest on Asteroid M, blamed for his supposed death.

their_evidence: Sanctuary, Part 1 (#48): Magneto offers to let Xavier and his two escorts, Gambit and Beast, join him on Asteroid M; after Fabian Cortez ejects Magneto into space and blames the X-Men, Gambit stays behind and is imprisoned for Magneto's murder. Gambit never fights Magneto in this series.

stages.title: X-Men '97#16
stages.text: Lorna returns to Xavier's school, and he helps her face her feelings about her father to defeat Danger.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier helps her face her father's memory.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Helps Lorna face her feelings about her father.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#37
proposed.text: Xavier tells Jubilee about Iceman and Lorna, who once served on his X-Men, and the X-Men find Lorna again as a member of X-Factor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A former X-Man who joins X-Factor.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Led Lorna in the early X-Men.

their_evidence: Cold Comfort (#37): Xavier explains Iceman's past to Jubilee, including his girlfriend Lorna Dane; the episode establishes Lorna as an early X-Man beside Iceman, and the X-Men find her in Forge's X-Factor, where she chooses to stay.

stages.title: X-Men '97#5
stages.text: Gambit dies destroying Master Mold to save Genosha.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Remy dies destroying their Master Mold.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Destroys the Sentinels' Master Mold.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
proposed.text: Gambit fights off a Sentinel hunting Jubilee at a mall, alongside Storm and Rogue.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mutant-hunting robots Remy fights at a mall.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights a Sentinel at a mall to save Jubilee.

their_evidence: Night of the Sentinels, Part I (#1): a Sentinel breaks into the mall searching for Jubilee, and Storm, Rogue and Gambit fight it off.

stages.title: X-Men '97#16
stages.text: Apocalypse raises Gambit from the dead as Death, one of his Horsemen.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Raises and controls Remy.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Apocalypse's Horseman.

stages.title: X-Men '97#18
stages.text: Apocalypse's own mind hides inside Gambit and controls him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hides his mind inside Remy and controls him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Apocalypse's Horseman, with Apocalypse's mind inside him.

stages.title: X-Men '97#19
stages.text: When Cable shoots Remy, Apocalypse bursts out and twists Remy's body into a monstrous form. Rogue frees Remy and traps Apocalypse's mind in a crystal.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes over Remy's body until Rogue frees Remy.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Has his body seized by Apocalypse until Rogue frees it.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
proposed.text: Gambit fights Apocalypse with the X-Men after Archangel goes after him, and Apocalypse reveals he set them all up to be rid of them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sets a trap for Remy and the X-Men.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Apocalypse with the X-Men.

their_evidence: Obsession (#35): Archangel hunts Apocalypse and the X-Men (Gambit featured) join the fight; Apocalypse explains he set both Archangel and the X-Men up to be rid of them, nearly kills them, and is launched into space by his ship.

stages.title: X-Men '97#14
stages.text: In ancient Egypt, Rogue watches young En Sabah Nur become Apocalypse.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The tyrant Rogue watches rise in ancient Egypt.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Watches Apocalypse rise in ancient Egypt.

stages.title: X-Men '97#19
stages.text: With a Celestial's power, Rogue pulls Apocalypse out of Gambit and traps him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue pulls him out of Gambit and traps him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Pulls Apocalypse out of Gambit and traps him.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#10
proposed.text: Rogue exposes Apocalypse's scheme on Muir Island. At Stonehenge he moves to kill her, and she breaks his hold on Archangel by absorbing it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tries to kill Rogue at Stonehenge.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Frees Archangel from Apocalypse's control.

their_evidence: Come the Apocalypse (#10): Rogue exposes Mystique and destroys the machine that made the Horsemen; at Stonehenge Apocalypse prepares to exterminate Rogue before the X-Men arrive, and Rogue absorbs Archangel's dark side, undoing Apocalypse's conditioning.

stages.title: X-Men '97#12
stages.text: Archangel executes War on Cable's orders.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Warren executes him on Cable's orders.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Executes War on Cable's orders.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#10
proposed.text: Made Horsemen of Apocalypse together, War and Archangel take down the French army in Paris, but once Rogue frees him, Archangel turns on the other Horsemen.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Horseman Warren turns on.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Horseman who turns on War.

their_evidence: Come the Apocalypse (#10): Apocalypse makes Archangel and Abraham Kieros (War) Horsemen; 'War and Archangel take down the French army'; after Rogue absorbs his dark side, Archangel tells the Horsemen to stop and blasts the other Horsemen away.

stages.title: X-Men '97#11
stages.text: In 3960 A.D., Apocalypse's followers capture Scott, Jean and young Nathan, whom Apocalypse wants as his next body.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Wants Scott's son as his next body.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The father of the boy Apocalypse wants.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
proposed.text: When Archangel goes after Apocalypse, Cyclops and the X-Men join the fight, and Apocalypse reveals he set them all up to be rid of them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sets a trap for Scott and the X-Men.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Apocalypse with the X-Men.

their_evidence: Obsession (#35): Cyclops is featured with Gambit, Wolverine, Beast and Rogue fighting Apocalypse after Archangel's attack; Apocalypse explains he set Archangel and the X-Men up to be rid of them, nearly kills them all, and is launched into space.

stages.title: X-Men '97#4
stages.text: After the X-Cutioner's blast strips Storm's powers, Forge brings her to his ranch to restore them, and the two grow close.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Storm win back her powers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Grows close to Forge, who helps restore her powers.

stages.title: X-Men '97#6
stages.text: When the Adversary poisons Forge, Storm faces her fear, regains her powers, and heals him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Storm win back her powers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Grows close to Forge, who helps restore her powers.

question: In One Man's Worth, Part 2 (#55), the Storm of an erased alternate timeline (married to Wolverine there), with Bishop, Shard and Wolverine, convinces a 2055 Forge who doesn't know them to repair his time portal. That is the only exchange; Storm is absent from Cold Comfort and the Phalanx episodes only show her captured. Does that erased-timeline meeting count as a Storm and Forge stage?

stages.title: X-Men '97#7
stages.text: Rogue hunts Gyrich in Mexico and absorbs his memories.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue hunts him in Mexico.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Hunts Gyrich in Mexico.

question: In The Final Decision (#13) the X-Men capture Gyrich at the Lincoln Memorial and force Master Mold's location out of him; sources list Rogue in the episode (and on the surface team later) but don't say she is in the Gyrich scene. Add a stage or none?

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
stages.text: Anne Weaver sits on Robert Gonzales' council, which sees Skye's new powers as a threat and sends agents to bring her in.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A gifted agent Weaver's council sends people to bring in.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A council member wary of Daisy's powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
stages.text: Weaver wants the Inhumans treated as a threat, but when Jiaying's Inhumans seize the Iliad, Skye and Coulson's team retake the ship and save her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman Weaver's council debated capturing, who later saves her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A council member wary of Daisy's powers, whom Daisy later helps save.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#12
proposed.text: Anne Weaver calls Skye and the team to the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy to find who is behind the freezing attacks on her cadets.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps investigate the attacks on Weaver's cadets.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Academy head who calls in Skye's team.

their_evidence: Seeds (S1#12): Ward, Fitz, Simmons and Skye are sent to the Academy; Weaver greets and briefs them, with an on-screen exchange between Weaver, Ward and Skye about 'bad seeds'. Coulson and May are in Mexico City.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth to stop the Kree warrior Vin-Tak, who wants to kill Skye after her powers emerge, and Sif decides Skye should be taken to Asgard. She relents only after seeing Skye risk herself to protect her friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian who wants to take Daisy to Asgard, until Daisy proves herself.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new Inhuman Sif wants taken to Asgard, until she risks herself for her friends.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#15
proposed.text: When Lorelei takes over the Bus, Skye helps trick her into the interrogation room, where Sif is waiting to collar her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian Skye helps trap Lorelei for.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps lure Lorelei into Sif's trap.

their_evidence: Yes Men (S1#15): Sif hunts Lorelei with Coulson's team; Simmons and Skye trick Lorelei into the interrogation room where Sif confronts and collars her.
